name: Kyogase (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kyogase village emblem in yellow: an outlined five-lobed flower shape enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former village of Kyogase in Niigata Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1974.

features.role: Kyogase village emblem — an outlined five-lobed flower shape enclosing a stylised character
